lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are arranged in a repeating, approximately rectangular grid along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of increased pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a visible lattice structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear features are present in the upper third of the flank, showing a sharp vertical transition from high luminance to shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Several associated teleost fish (remoras) are visible, including one attached to the lower flank and several others in the surrounding water column.
